mapper.sql: id AS employeeId, name_kh AS nameKh, `name` AS nameEn, code AS employeesCode, (SELECT name FROM positions WHERE id = position_id) AS positionName, (SELECT name FROM departments WHERE id = department_id) AS departmentName, account_number AS bankAccount, account_id AS accountNumber, telephone AS telephone, employees.gender AS gender, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_of_months),0) FROM payroll_details WHERE is_active = 1 AND payroll_item_id = 10 AND amount > 0 AND payroll_id IN (SELECT id FROM payrolls WHERE is_active = 1 AND employee_id = employees.id AND payrolls.pay_date <= #{filter.filterMonth})) AS totalOfMonth, (SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM payroll_details WHERE is_active = 1 AND payroll_item_id = 10 AND payroll_id IN (SELECT id FROM payrolls WHERE is_active = 1 AND employee_id = employees.id AND payrolls.pay_date <= #{filter.filterMonth} )) - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM provident_fund_details WHERE is_active = 1 AND status = 2 AND employee_id = employees.id AND provident_fund_id IN (SELECT id FROM provident_funds WHERE is_active = 1 AND date <= #{filter.filterMonth}))) AS providentFundAmount
mapper.select: SELECT provident_funds.id AS id, DATE_FORMAT(request_date, "%d-%b-%Y") AS requestDate, date AS filterMonth, title AS title FROM provident_funds WHERE is_active = 1 AND id = #{id}

SELECT provident_funds.date AS filterMonth, pfd.status AS status, pfd.amount AS amountRequest, pfd.employee_id AS employeeId, employees.code AS employeesCode, employees.name_kh AS nameKh, employees.name_en AS nameEn, employees.gender AS gender, employees.telephone AS telephone, positions.name AS positionName, departments.name AS departmentName, employees.account_number AS bankAccount, employees.account_id as accountNumber, (SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM payroll_details WHERE is_active = 1 AND payroll_item_id = 10 AND payroll_id IN (SELECT id FROM payrolls WHERE is_active = 1 AND employee_id = pfd.employee_id AND payrolls.pay_date <= #{filterMonth} )) - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM provident_fund_details WHERE is_active = 1 AND employee_id = pfd.employee_id AND provident_fund_id IN (SELECT id FROM provident_funds WHERE is_active = 1 AND date < #{filterMonth}) )) AS providentFundAmount, pfd.amount AS providentFundAmount, IFNULL(pfd.total_months, 0) AS totalOfMonth, IFNULL(pfd.bonus_amount, 0) AS bonusHaftProfundAmount FROM provident_fund_details AS pfd INNER JOIN provident_funds ON provident_funds.id = pfd.provident_fund_id INNER JOIN employees ON employees.id = pfd.employee_id LEFT JOIN positions ON positions.id = employees.position_id LEFT JOIN departments ON departments.id = employees.department_id WHERE pfd.is_active = 1 AND pfd.provident_fund_id = #{proFundId}
mapper.sql: *, DATE_FORMAT(request_date, "%d-%b-%Y") AS requestDate, DATE_FORMAT(created, "%d-%m-%Y %k:%i") AS createdDate, DATE_FORMAT(modified, "%d-%m-%Y %k:%i") AS modifiedDate, title AS title, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM provident_fund_details WHERE provident_fund_id = provident_funds.id AND is_active = 1) AS amountRequest, (SELECT username FROM users WHERE id = provident_funds.created_by) AS createdByName, (SELECT username FROM users WHERE id = provident_funds.modified_by) AS modifiedByName
mapper.select: SELECT request_date FROM provident_funds WHERE is_active = 1 AND status = 2 AND id IN (SELECT provident_fund_id FROM provident_fund_details WHERE is_active = 1 AND employee_id = #{employeeId}) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 01
